description: This file is a shell script used for testing git commit templates and behaviors, including verbose diffs, commit message formats, and configuration options. It sets up various git commit scenarios and verifies the outputs to ensure the correctness of verbose commit functionalities.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates executable script files with specified contents.

methods.name: test_set_editor
methods.description: Sets the environment's GIT_EDITOR to a specified script.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks that the output contains the expected number of lines.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Verifies or sets global git configurations.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for patterns in files and verifies matches.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
